collection.title: Mazda MX-5 1989 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mazda MX-5 1989 to 2005 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
